objective: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.

description: Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination.  I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.
That is... I will if all goes according to plan.  If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.
completion: The ritual was a success.  I have seen Sharpbeak and can tell you how to find him.
